answer_1.quote: We test our EDMem framework on two testbeds of entity knowledge: open-domain QA and entity-intensive generation tasks.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text including answers, explanations, and dialogue responses.

answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE and unigram F1 scores, as well as BERTScore for semantic-based evaluation.

answer_4.quote: we leverage Amazon's MTurk platform to conduct human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: For fluency, relevance and correctness metrics, annotators are asked to give scores on a 1-3 scale. For informativeness and reasonability, ranking evaluation is applied.
